# Talky

> Talky is a native macOS app for hold-to-talk dictation, voice memos, and meeting transcription with speaker labels. Speech is transcribed locally on your Mac with Parakeet. Optional API key for summary and text polish. Coming soon.

Talky is an independent app built by Dawid Woźniak and Sature.

## What it does

- Hold Control+Shift to dictate into any text field
- Voice memos and searchable scratchpad
- Meeting notes with speaker labels from mic and system audio
- Local Parakeet transcription on your Mac
- Optional API key for text polish and summaries
- Coming soon
